Public preview; Android hardware verification is still in progress. Cinema runs inside Kodi while this APK provides setup and the local BT engine. Sign in with your own accounts and play only media you have rights to access.

Control endpoints require per-install random credentials. The engine binds to localhost only, though upstream stream and /echo routes may not enforce auth; this is not full media isolation from other local apps.

Started manually by you and stoppable anytime from its notification. Never auto-starts on boot, downloads new binaries, enables Accessibility, or requests root. Keep running while watching in Kodi; stop when finished.

Cinema runs inside Kodi. This Helper does not bundle Kodi or replace existing players. Download Kodi for Android from the official site, then return here to install Cinema.

1. Save the repository file to Downloads.
2. In Kodi → Add-ons → Install from zip file, choose repository.bobbi.zip.
3. Install from repository → bobbi TV → Program add-ons → bobbi Get Started. Remaining components download automatically.

Future updates arrive via the same Kodi repository; APK updates still require Android confirmation. Never flashes firmware or alters AV settings.
Repository file saved. Next, install from ZIP in Kodi, then install "bobbi Get Started" from the bobbi repository.
